method: Actual model visual inspection via tools.view_image of 10 contact sheets and 7 individual extracted sample JPEGs; no human real-time playback or audio listening.

checks.result: No blocking text or anchor overlap found. Compression and tension labels sit on opposite sides of the isolated purlin; subtitle and diverging MPa legend occupy separate areas.
Sampled camera progression tracks the same pavilion from roof/bracket toward column. Pillar label remains beside its anchor; subtitle does not obscure the bracket contact being explained.
Stone-base label sits beside the front base. Reaction vectors remain spatially tied to bases; 6108.6 N caption is separated from the speech subtitle.
Pavilion remains present through the sampled transition; camera withdraws and roof becomes opaque. Wind heading enters from the right edge without blocking the pavilion in its settled position.
Flow lines, roof arrows and rotating pavilion are visible together. Explicit two-dimensional-flow wording is visible. Main heading clears before closer roof-force explanation.

checks.topic: wind: load transfer and diagonal braces
checks.result: See-through roof exposes supports. Contrasting blue/red brace colors align with visible brace surfaces; signed MPa legend is separate. No visible detached stress layer or subtitle occlusion of the brace endpoints.
Deformed colored structure remains aligned in the samples. The two labels enter sequentially and remain outside their anchor surfaces. MPa color scale and displacement x250 wording are both visible.
Colored/deformed view returns to timber pavilion while keeping its visual identity and continuous sampled camera framing. Return heading enters from the right edge.
Large breathing space around the whole pavilion; subtitles remain in the bottom band. Sampled frames retain the pavilion through the beginning of the references section.

References move into the frame from the right in the sampled boundary sequence. Settled layout has real paper pages filling their card areas, titles/authors/years below cards, technical route and formulas separated at left. No clipped settled text or card/caption overlap.

issues.description: During close wind-load shots, the roof moves behind the top-left brand, reducing local contrast relative to the otherwise clear cream background. The brand remains readable in the inspected samples; no educational label or caption is blocked.
issues.recommendation: Optional future polish: retain a subtle cream backing or preserve more upper-left camera headroom for the brand.

coda_observation.text: About 9.73 seconds between first inspected fully settled coda and last inspected frame; this is sampled evidence, not a continuous playback timing certification.

limits: This is model-based sampled-frame review, not human real-time viewing.
No claim of complete frame-by-frame or continuous-motion coverage; no between-sample pop, short occlusion, acceleration or jitter can be ruled out solely by this review.
Audio intelligibility, pronunciation and musical taste were not evaluated.
Physics values, native solver provenance and scientific correctness were not recomputed in this visual review.
Individual sample JPEGs are the existing extraction resolution; the full MP4 was not re-encoded or modified.
